fragment_sampling: Uniform fragment length max(180, read_length+20)..300, then uniform valid start conditional on fragment containing center300. Target-enriched toy locus sampling, not whole-genome coverage. Both FR strands equiprobable.
truth_definition: A complete target or reverse complement exists in at least one positive-weight generating template before read sampling and sequencing errors. Never conditioned on observing an exact target read. Each sample is scored only against its designated target.

noise_definition.error_1pct: Independent 0.01 substitution probability per sequenced base, each alternative equiprobable; every base Q20. No indels.
noise_definition.quality_patch: No substitutions; ten contiguous bases per read assigned Q10 at a uniformly selected start, remaining bases Q40. This separates quality filtering from sequence corruption; not a calibrated sequencing-error model.

stress_interpretation: Constructed complementary variant mixtures test mechanisms; not estimated genomic prevalence. Endpoint stress is deliberately adversarial. Present diluted10 has only10% template sampling probability; finite reads may contain zero target-origin molecules.
deduplication: Ordered R1/R2 sequence pair identity, ignoring quality and origin IDs; not independent molecule or biological replicate counting. Evidence must co-occur in one observation to count same-pair/read.
metrics: Report positive-call rate per template/noise/read-length/pair-count stratum, method, quality, support unit and threshold. On truth-present strata this is sensitivity; on truth-absent strata false-positive rate. No prevalence-weighted overall accuracy, p-values or genomic confidence intervals. All criteria see identical reads.
method_note: Pooled, same-pair and same-read criteria compare unique canonical k-mer sets and ignore order and multiplicity. Exact checks the complete contiguous target in either orientation. Full-length k is an equivalence check, not an independent baseline. Aho-Corasick is a matching implementation, not biological novelty.
rng_note: SHA256-derived per-target/template/cell seeds. Geometry cellseed excludes noise_model; noise RNG is separate, preserving fragment origins across noise conditions. No Python process hash. Standard Python random.Random; record Python version and read digests.
scope_limits: Synthetic mechanism benchmark, not independent biological validation or GWAS.
Targets were selected in earlier discrepancy analysis; no general genomic error-rate claim.
No whole-genome background, abundance estimation, indels, PCR model, contamination, real base-quality calibration or genotype calling.
Reference/original FASTQ files are neither downloaded nor rescanned.
Do not reclassify the original60 cases as false positives based on simulation.
Primary and sensitivity analyses are frozen before execution; no post hoc threshold tuning.
